flowForm.title: New Flow
flowForm.description: A Flow defines the lifecycle of a document: which steps it goes through, who can act at each step, which transitions are allowed, and which rules control routing, formalization, and dissemination. After creating the flow, access the detail to add steps, transitions, roles, and rules.
flowForm.nameHint: Descriptive name of the flow. E.g.: "Intelligence Report Flow".
flowForm.codeHint: Unique identifier of the flow, used internally for reference. E.g.: "FLOW-RELINT".
flowForm.descriptionHint: Explain the purpose of the flow and in which situations it should be used.
flowForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the purpose and usage context of this flow
flowForm.scopeHint: Area or sector of the organization to which this flow applies. E.g.: "Intelligence Superintendence".
flowForm.statusHint: Draft: under configuration, not available for use. Active: available to create documents. Inactive: disabled.
flowForm.docTypesHint: Select which document types this flow governs. A flow can cover multiple document types of the same nature.

stepEditor.title: Flow Steps
stepEditor.description: A step represents a state of the document within the flow — for example, "In Production", "In Review" or "Formalized". Each step has a type that defines what can happen in it and a primary responsible role. After creating steps, go to the Transitions tab to connect them.
stepEditor.saveAllHint: Persists all steps to the database
stepEditor.nameHint: Readable name of the step. E.g.: "Document Production", "Chief Review".
stepEditor.codeHint: Unique identifier of the step within the flow. E.g.: "PRODUCTION", "CHIEF_REVIEW".
stepEditor.typeHint: Defines the step behavior: Production (editing), Review, Formalization (freezes document), Internal/External Dissemination, Operational Task or Terminal State.
stepEditor.orderHint: Number indicating the position of this step in the flow sequence. Used only for visual ordering.
stepEditor.roleHint: Flow role that is the primary responsible for this step. Must be a role already registered in the Roles tab.
stepEditor.mandatoryHint: If checked, the document cannot skip this step.
stepEditor.descriptionHint: Explain what happens in this step and what actions are expected from the responsible.
stepEditor.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what happens in this step
stepEditor.emptyMessage: No steps added. Click "Add Step" to start. Remember to include at least one initial step (Production) and one final step (Terminal State).
transitionEditor.title: Flow Transitions
transitionEditor.description: A transition connects two steps, defining how the document advances (or returns) in the flow. For example: "Send for Review" connects the Production step to the Review step. You need to have steps registered before creating transitions.
transitionEditor.nameHint: Name of the action that moves the document. E.g.: "Send for Review", "Return with Notes", "Formalize".
transitionEditor.typeHint: Approval: advances the document. Return: returns for correction. Resubmit: resends without change. Formalization: consolidates final version. Dissemination: starts distribution.
transitionEditor.fromStepHint: Step where the document is when this transition can be executed.
transitionEditor.toStepHint: Step to which the document will be moved after this transition.
transitionEditor.descriptionHint: Describe the conditions or context in which this transition should be used.
transitionEditor.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe when and how this transition should be used
transitionEditor.emptyMessage: No transitions added. Make sure you have steps registered before creating transitions.
roleEditor.title: Flow Roles
roleEditor.description: A flow role is a functional role within the workflow — such as Producer, Reviewer, or Formalizer. Each role is mapped to a combination of organizational unit + profile, defining who in the organization can perform that function in this flow. The Dissemination Executor role is typically the Protocol office, which executes external dissemination without editing analytical content.
roleEditor.functionHint: Creator: initiates the document. Producer: writes the content. Reviewer: evaluates and approves. Formalizer: consolidates the final version. Dissemination Authorizer: authorizes external sending. Dissemination Executor: executes the sending (usually Protocol).
roleEditor.nameHint: Descriptive name of the role in this flow. E.g.: "Analyst Producer", "Chief Reviewer".
roleEditor.descriptionHint: Describe the specific responsibilities of this role in this flow.
roleEditor.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the responsibilities of this role
roleEditor.orgUnitProfileHint: Select the unit and profile that perform this role. Expand the tree on the left to choose the unit, then select the profile on the right. Leave blank to allow any authorized actor by the rules.
roleEditor.emptyMessage: No roles added. Define at least the Producer and Formalizer roles for the flow to work correctly.
roleEditor.creator: Creator
ruleEditor.title: Flow Rules
ruleEditor.description: Rules control who can execute each action in the flow. A Creation rule defines who can initiate a document. A Routing rule defines who can send and to whom. A Dissemination rule defines who can distribute the document. Each rule has an origin (who acts) and a target (to whom), both defined by unit + profile combination.
ruleEditor.nameHint: Descriptive name of the rule. E.g.: "Analyst can create RELINT".
ruleEditor.typeHint: Creation: who initiates. Routing: who sends and to whom. Formalization: who formalizes. Internal/External Dissemination: who distributes.
ruleEditor.scopeHint: Permission: authorizes. Restriction: limits to conditions. Prohibition: absolutely prohibits.
ruleEditor.actionHint: Action that the target must execute. E.g.: REVIEW, FORMALIZATION, ACKNOWLEDGMENT.
ruleEditor.priorityHint: Higher number = higher priority when multiple rules apply.
ruleEditor.originHint: Unit + profile that can execute this action. Leave blank for any actor.
ruleEditor.targetLabel: Target (to whom the action is directed)
ruleEditor.targetHint: Unit + profile that receives the action. Applicable in routing and dissemination. Leave blank for any target.
ruleEditor.emptyMessage: No rules added. Without rules, any authenticated user can execute any action in the flow.
exceptionEditor.title: Flow Exceptions
exceptionEditor.description: An exception replaces or complements a general rule for specific origin and target combinations. Use exceptions to handle cases such as: an administratively external sector that is functionally authorized to receive documents, or an absolute prohibition for a specific combination. Exceptions take priority over general rules.
exceptionEditor.nameHint: Descriptive name of the exception. E.g.: "Protocol can receive external documents".
exceptionEditor.namePlaceholder: E.g.: Protocol can receive external documents
exceptionEditor.typeHint: Type of action this exception affects.
exceptionEditor.scopeHint: Permission: authorizes the exception. Restriction: limits. Prohibition: absolutely prohibits this specific combination.
exceptionEditor.actionHint: Specific action this exception covers. Leave blank to cover all actions of the selected type.
exceptionEditor.priorityHint: Higher number = higher priority. Exceptions usually have higher priority than general rules.
exceptionEditor.originHint: Unit + profile to which this exception applies as origin.
exceptionEditor.targetHint: Unit + profile to which this exception applies as target.
exceptionEditor.emptyMessage: No exceptions added. Exceptions are optional and only needed when general rules don't cover specific cases.

documentInstance.description: A Document is an individual documentary piece that goes through a workflow flow. Select the template that defines the type of document to be produced — the system will automatically identify the current flow. The document can be created within an existing process or standalone.
documentInstance.titleHint: Descriptive title of the document. E.g.: "Intelligence Report - Operation North - Jan/2024".
documentInstance.templateHint: Select the document model to be produced. E.g.: RELINT (Intelligence Report), PB (Search Request). When selected, the system will automatically filter available flows.
documentInstance.flowHint: Select the flow that will govern the lifecycle of this document. The flow defines the steps, who can act, and how the document routes until formalized and disseminated.
documentInstance.flowVersionHint: The current version is automatically selected when choosing the flow. The document will be linked to this version throughout its lifecycle.
documentInstance.flowVersionRequired: Flow version is required. Make sure the selected flow has a published version.
documentInstance.noPublishedVersion: No published version available for this flow. Publish a version before creating documents.
documentInstance.processHint: Link this document to an existing process for consolidated tracking. Leave blank to create a standalone document, independent of any process.
documentInstance.processPlaceholder: Select a process or leave blank
documentInstance.contentHint: Initial text of the document. Can be filled now or during the production step in the flow.
documentInstance.contentPlaceholder: Initial document content (can be filled later)
documentInstance.originHint: Select the organizational unit and profile of the person responsible for creating this document. This information is used to validate the flow's creation rules.
